before.title: SX4 1.9 DDiS EGR + DPF Issues (Fiat-Sourced Diesel)
before.description: The 1.9 DDiS in the SX4 is the Fiat Multijet 8V 939A engine, shared with Croma/Bravo. Same EGR cooler clogging, DPF regeneration failures, and turbo actuator wear issues as in Fiat applications. Short-trip duty cycles especially destructive — DPF cannot complete passive regen.
before.solution: EGR clean: £150-£300. DPF forced regen (dealer): £80-£150 if not yet collapsed; full DPF replacement £700-£1,400. Drive at sustained 70+ mph for 20+ min monthly to enable passive regen. Many independents will EGR/DPF delete + remap — illegal in most markets.
